title: Signal to Decision
objective: Make the operating model memorable and decision-ready.
creativeThesis: Turn fragmented signals into one visible decision path.

narrativeDirection.rationale: The audience needs a concise operating sequence from scorecard to decision.
adaptations: Open with the operating model rather than a period recap.
Resolve each evidence section with a named leadership decision.

visualDirection.name: Signal Path
visualDirection.rationale: The direction explains the operating model while giving every proof a visible role.
visualDirection.contentSpecificIdea: Fragmented operating signals become one decision path.
visualDirection.signatureMove: A continuous signal line changes state at each decision.
visualDirection.visualGrammar: Wide proof fields, one strong convergence line, and deliberate reset slides.

themeDecision.rationale: The audience needs a clear operational system with restrained authority.
adaptations: Use the operating signal path as the recurring composition instead of a generic grid motif.
Assign the accent color only to decision-state changes and verified metrics.

layoutStrategy.selectionRationale: The content alternates system explanation, proof, and decision frames.
layoutStrategy.customCompositionPolicy: Use custom-composition only when the operating signal path cannot be represented by a registered diagram layout.

aesthetic: The signal path is memorable and content-specific.
technical: All slides render without blocking defects.
